specs.title: point snapping honors transformed anchors, physical tolerance and endpoint priority over grids
curve snapping projects onto exact cubics and alignment targets without moving existing geometry
snap targets exclude selected anchors and adjacent segments but include locked visible references
angle snapping remains independent of the magnet and never bends a constrained handle toward off-angle targets
editable arcs preserve signed sweeps, tangent continuity and chord or pie closure
text metadata and outlined multilingual Latin glyphs round-trip and render without any font dependency
text font-size and content edits preserve rotated resized geometry while outlining removes only text metadata
empty text and invalid typography are bounded, finite and still editable
Bézier boolean union, difference, intersection and exclusion retain exact filled silhouettes
compound boolean holes, empty results and protected or open sources are handled atomically
stamp projects preserve mixed runs, static SVG and embedded images without retaining foreign fields
character-range formatting splits and coalesces styles, preserves unselected text and supports empty text
rich-text insertion and replacement keep style boundaries and literal markup as text, not executable content
stamp validators reject scripts, missing/duplicate identities, foreign rasters, caps and oversized files
all 14 channel targets can be toggled independently with the Normal/Height dependency and exact zero retained
decals store finite normalized object-space transforms, clamp geometry and reject identities/foreign coordinate spaces
a regular layer hosts decals and a Decal layer hosts many placements while deduplicating the immutable stamp snapshot
re-saving changed artwork does not mutate placed decals or allocate another snapshot for every new dab
folder/layer/component locks protect decal mutations; eyes and unlocking remain available
layer duplication creates independent component identities, removal prunes only unused stamp snapshots
decal caps, total byte budgets, missing stamp references and cross-layer identity collisions cannot bypass validation
channel-disabled decals are muted, mask stamps still work and hidden folders suppress their whole subtree
projected triangles are surface-clipped, forward-facing and specimen-local even on a translated/rotated mesh
surface-mask GPU data packs true inverse projector transforms, atlas rectangles, mask mode and owner identities
before/after/inside drop positions use siblings, atomically move complete folder subtrees and reject self/cycles/locks
a surface placement and a transform gesture are undoable whole-document transactions with portable stamp snapshots
explicit artwork replacement retains instance transforms, prunes the old snapshot and cannot alter component identities through a patch
sixteen distinct embedded snapshots remain bounded; replacing an exclusively used snapshot at the cap does not require a seventeenth slot
locked decal descendants protect layer/subtree moves, copies and deletion as well as their own inspector
drop feedback rejects over-depth folder nesting before mutating the tree
canonical transforms are idempotent and imported stamp projects without an identity get a real stable string ID
Stamp stack uses shared search, counts, filters and keyboard-accessible additive menu
Canvas backgrounds persist as view preferences without altering exported decal pixels or history
Stamp viewport coordinates use both canvas dimensions at any zoom
G translates from the snapshot, with exact bounds, 8px snapping and X/Y constraints
R rotates about the artwork pivot, supports accumulated turns and snaps by 15 degrees
S preserves aspect ratio and clamps the shared factor rather than distorting either dimension
S X/Y changes only its constrained dimension
starting R or S over the pivot remains finite, smooth and bounded
corner resizing follows rotated local axes and never mutates the component snapshot
Tangent rectangle/ellipse difference retains corners and removes the centre
Tangent rectangle/ellipse exclude retains corners and removes the centre
Boolean holes survive a second operation, transforms and serialization
Stamp shared vector booleans retain corner pixels, native artwork, undo and export
Stamp vector drawing, pen finalization, shared gradients and editable preset round trip
